nodes.title: 参数口径（表里所有值都按这个来）
widgets_values:
表里的 Tile / 重叠 / 渐变都是输出像素，32 的倍数（代码里 //16 换成 latent）。

重叠 = 1/3 × Tile 高，渐变 = 重叠（填满整个重叠区做渐变，别留硬拼段）。

8G → Tile ≤ 672×384、重叠 / 渐变 128

12G → Tile ≤ 960×544、重叠 / 渐变 192

16G → Tile ≤ 1344×768、重叠 / 渐变 256

目标分辨率 ≤ 单块上限时，直接**关掉「二采分块采样」**跑整幅即可。

minimax_h3_prompt_reference_doc.text:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the reference image for the female subject, showing a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved t-shirt and black leggings, with a neutral standing pose.
<Picture 2> is the reference image for the environment, showing a futuristic, high-tech interior space with curved white walls, a large circular window looking out into space, and modern furniture.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> performing exercise movements in <Subject 2>. The video begins with <Subject 1> in a neutral standing pose and transitions through a sequence of facial expressions representing anger, sadness, and happiness, while maintaining the exercise posture. The environment remains consistent throughout, derived from <Subject 2>.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame, [Shot 2] keyframe, [Shot 3] keyframe, [Shot 4] keyframe, [Shot 5] keyframe, [Shot 6] keyframe, [Shot 7] keyframe, [Shot 8] keyframe, [Shot 9] keyframe, [Shot 10] keyframe): fully_preserved - the subject's appearance (long dark hair, white t-shirt, black leggings) and the specific facial expressions (neutral, happy, angry, sad, laughing) are retained as keyframes for the animation sequence.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 1] first frame, [Shot 2] first frame, [Shot 3] first frame, [Shot 4] first frame, [Shot 5] first frame, [Shot 6] first frame, [Shot 7] first frame, [Shot 8] first frame, [Shot 9] first frame, [Shot 10] first frame): fully_preserved - the futuristic interior environment with curved white architecture and the space view is retained as the continuous background.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a realistic, slightly stylized 3D animation style with soft, even studio lighting.
[Shot 1] The scene opens in a medium-full shot of <Subject 1>, the young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and black leggings, standing in a neutral pose in the center of <Subject 2>, the futuristic white interior. She faces slightly to the left.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, corresponding to the "happy" expression in <Picture 1>. She smiles broadly, showing her teeth, with eyes crinkled in a genuine, joyful expression. Her body remains in a relaxed standing position.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, corresponding to the "angry" expression in <Picture 1>. Her eyebrows are furrowed, eyes narrowed, and her mouth is set in a firm, slightly downturned line, conveying clear irritation.
[Shot 4] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, corresponding to the "sad" expression in <Picture 1>. Her eyebrows are raised and drawn together, eyes look downcast, and her mouth is turned down at the corners, conveying a sense of melancholy.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, corresponding to the "laughing" expression in <Picture 1>. Her head is tilted slightly, eyes are squinted in mirth, and her mouth is open in a wide, open-mouthed laugh.
[Shot 6] At 00:07.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, returning to the "happy" expression. The smile is bright and engaging.
[Shot 7] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, returning to the "angry" expression. The intensity of the frown is maintained.
[Shot 8] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, returning to the "sad" expression. The downturned mouth and downcast eyes are prominent.
[Shot 9] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, returning to the "laughing" expression. The joyful, open-mouthed laugh is clear.
[Shot 10] At 00:13.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, returning to the "happy" expression. The smile is bright and engaging.

overall_soundscape:
Soft, ambient electronic music with a slow, steady beat plays in the background. The sound of faint, rhythmic breathing is audible, synchronized with the subtle movements of the subject.

non_diegetic_music:
A minimal, atmospheric electronic track with a slow tempo, featuring soft synthesizer pads and a subtle, rhythmic pulse. The music is calm and supports the mood of the exercise session without overpowering the visual focus on the facial expressions.
